title: Cardinal of Como (papal Secretariat) to Anselmo Dandini, nuncio in France, 16 May 1580 (ASV Segr. Stato Francia 283C f. 52, DECODE R72)

steps.what: DECODE R72-R73 metadata, 4 page images, 11 DOC images and 6 DOC text files fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R73 decryption found on the records.
Lasry's reconstructed key applied to the R72 transcription (DP parse). Parse fits the frame (only code 38 unknown) but the letters are nonsense: different letter assignment.
Homophonic annealing on a naive 2-digit tokenisation of R72. Free assignment collapsed to a constant string; fixed-multiset swaps did not converge (misaligned tokens).

Swap annealing of letter values on the DP parse, nomenclator words fixed as plaintext, Italian 4-grams from it-renaissance. Readable Italian at once: 'la voce et l'opinione della pratica ... con la monaca e uscita tanto publica'.
Clear block at the foot of f. 52 transcribed and recognised as the contemporary decipherment; decryption aligned with it, three codes corrected (22 l, 62 e, 72 i).

Split from the former combined target (catalogue 244, R72 + R73) under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R72 keeps this entry with its rebuilt letter key; R73, read with Lasry's key D3190 (a different letter assignment in the same frame), is now dandini1580r73. Earlier steps are kept as recorded; R72 measured on its own key with measure_r72.py: 495 of 509 parsed tokens have a value (97.2%).

outcome.method_basis: R72 has its contemporary decipherment written out below the figures on f. 52; the project transcribed and checked it, and rebuilt R72's own letter key by annealing inside the frame and nomenclator of Lasry's R73 key, corrected against the leaf's decipherment.
outcome.notes: R72 read (contemporary decipherment confirmed by the recovered key); four nomenclator groups open. R73 split off to dandini1580r73.
